cohort: All patients with a history of a previous cesarean delivery at a tertiary care center over a 4-year period, plus cases of uterine rupture from 1988 to the present
finding: While uterine rupture is a potential complication of TOLAC, it is a rare event with overall excellent maternal and neonatal outcomes, and invasive placentation, which increases in risk with each cesarean delivery, may carry a higher risk of complications.
